classification: CALCULATED / host simulation, not MCU physical demonstration

RTC.backup: CR1220 -> BAS116 ->1k -> VBACKUP; BSM10 LSM explicitly programmed, trickle disabled. Verify readback.

PWM.AF_and_LEVEL: LEVEL DC and AF equal offset+sine; KEY selects waveform on RF board. Maintain phase and approximately3ms transition ramps.
PWM.warning: Codes are bounded bench starting examples, not RF power or AM calibration. 8bit quantization RMS after2.8gain about10.5mV. ISR/LUT/latency remain target implementation and scope qualification gates.

Morse.foundation: Host SOS edge fixture. Dedicated GPTimer/RMT resources reserved independently of SPI/USB/LoRa.

progress.producer: Meaningful control-loop progress commit; never autonomous PWM/ISR

clock_correction: Freeze active slot deadline in monotonic time. Apply small corrections off-slot; large/invalid time disarms and requires deliberate restart. No wall-clock step may extend an active slot.
